graph.scope: Similarity network, not a causal/social/contact graph. Thresholds and k are exploratory display settings.
graph.rule: Undirected mutual5 nearest neighbors by full masked TF-IDF cosine, no minimum threshold; ties by source ID.

channel_similarity.scope: Dependent descriptive pairs; null within singleton context; no agreement or independent sample-size claim.

rows.scope: Dependent descriptive stability; full and control neighbors use the identical available-source subset.

projection.scope: Lossy centered/RMS-scaled 2D display; original-space cosines are authoritative.

sensitivity.cluster_rule: Fixed illustrative k=8, seed11 on unit-normalized 50D TF-IDF SVD; k=4,6,10 are diagnostics, not a selected optimum.

publisher_context.scope: Availability-adjusted neighbor enrichment, descriptively macro-averaged over groups; no independent-pair p-value.

creator_context.scope: Availability-adjusted neighbor enrichment, descriptively macro-averaged over groups; no independent-pair p-value.

text_origin.scope: Availability-adjusted neighbor enrichment, descriptively macro-averaged over groups; no independent-pair p-value.

binding.token_pooling: Attention-mask mean including CLS/SEP, then chunk L2 normalization
binding.document_pooling: Content-wordpiece-weighted mean of normalized chunks, then document L2 normalization
binding.cache: Exact input/model/encoder-contract cache; private vectors and hashes retained.

semantic.input: Centered maximum300 lexical-word spans, masked with exactly the same phrase registry as TF-IDF.
semantic.scope: Pinned pretrained CPU baseline. No weight update, model distillation or claim of current SOTA accuracy.

settings.tokenizer: Unicode alphabetic tokens; apostrophes retained; casefold; straight apostrophe normalization.

settings.mask_scope: Exact declared phrase registry only. Residual names/attributions may remain; masking is a sensitivity, not anonymization.
settings.balanced_fit_selection: Per-context source-ID SHA256 ascending; up to10 selected source units, no minimum quota.
settings.topic_scale: UnitL2 components and reciprocally rescaled W; document L1 mixture.
settings.topic_scope: Exploratory factors of this corpus. Labels concatenate top terms, not validated interpretive categories.
settings.clustering: Fixed illustrative k=8, seed11 on unit-normalized 50D TF-IDF SVD; k=4,6,10 are diagnostics, not a selected optimum.
settings.document_weight: Each selected source unit receives equal weight; no independence or representative-sampling claim.
settings.pair_weight: Similarity cells average all source pairs excluding self pairs; within-context uses unordered distinct pairs.
settings.top_term_scores: Document scores are L2-normalized TF-IDF weights; context scores are source means; contrast scores subtract the equally weighted mean of other context means. These are not counts.
settings.runtime: CPU only; one OpenMP/BLAS/ONNX intra/inter thread; shared cloud quota4CPUs and32GiB, noGPU.

limitations: Corpus and publisher coverage are opportunistic, incomplete and strongly imbalanced; uploaded lifetime totals are unknown.
Source units, publisher contexts, creator contexts, accounts, recordings, claimed beings and text editions are different units.
Publisher-written bodies are not verbatim audio transcripts or proof of alignment; ASR accuracy is unvalidated.
Word/phrase cosine measures lexical or representation proximity, never agreement, truth, contradiction or shared origin.
Context, language style, text origin, date and length are confounded; controls are descriptive, not causal identification.
No inferential pairwise p-values: source pairs overlap and publisher episodes are not independent samples.
NMF factors and KMeans labels are illustrative choices; instability and component-count diagnostics remain visible.
Alphabetic tokenization can fragment alphanumeric labels (for example3D becomes d); factors may capture formatting or conversational register such as yeah instead of distinct doctrines.
Two-dimensional source layout is lossy; distances shown on screen are not authoritative original-space cosine.
Question punctuation cues and following context are unvalidated; no automatic common-answer/conflict labels are claimed.
Claimed-entity names are publisher/speaker attributions; sparse unharmonized labels do not justify civilization-level pooled inference.

figures.title: Corpus concentration and text origin
figures.caption: Counts refer to selected source/publication units, not all channel uploads. * marks contexts with fewer than five documents. Boxes show median and interquartile range, whiskers1.5×IQR; outliers hidden. Text origin is a confound, not a quality ranking.

figures.title: Exploratory topic mixtures
figures.caption: Eight fixed NMF components, seeded random initialization11, masked full-text TF-IDF. Labels are top terms. Each selected source has equal weight within its context. Low-n rows do not support generalization; seed and balanced-fit sensitivity are exported.

figures.title: Context similarities with dependent-pair denominators
figures.caption: All admitted cross-context source pairs are averaged. Diagonal cells use distinct unordered within-context pairs; self pairs removed. Only contexts with at least five sources are plotted; all26contexts and pair counts remain in JSON/CSV. Similarity is not agreement.

figures.title: Length, attribution, representation and context controls
figures.caption: All top5 comparisons use the same eligible source universe. Jaccard=intersection/union. Enrichment subtracts(count(group)−1)/(N−1), then averages within groups and equally across groups. Pairs and groups are dependent; these are descriptive controls, not causal tests.

figures.title: Source similarity network
figures.caption: 888 undirected mutual5 edges, no minimum cosine threshold. Colors are observed publisher contexts, not beings or social relationships. SVD display coordinates do not preserve all cosine distances; exact edges and metrics are exported.

figures.title: Text-origin and clustering diagnostics
figures.caption: KMeans uses normalized50D SVD features. The display uses2D SVD. Main k=8 is an illustrative fixed choice, not a validated true doctrine count; seed and alternative-k diagnostics remain visible.
